Checked the logic in the callback: line 19 computes the copy length as the minimum of the supplied buffer size (size*nmemb) and the remaining email data size. Thus len can never exceed the buffer that libcurl passes in ptr, preventing a buffer overflow. The source email_data_str is simply read in chunks via the callback and not written into a fixed-size array.

No additional checks are required beyond the min calculation; libcurl guarantees the buffer size supplied to the callback. Hence the trigger described in the report cannot occur.
